decisions.reason: Requiring base mounts for every board remains valid when the design contains one board, and the drop-retention requirement is unchanged.
The change to one PCB does not alter the required airflow below and above the sensors.
The board-count change does not resolve the display-size ambiguity or change the display cutout, mounting, connection, or cover-installation requirements.
The permitted enclosure methods for transmitting LED light remain valid independently of the PCB count.
The enclosure must remain easy to assemble regardless of whether it contains one or three PCBs.
Moving from three boards to one makes the prior interboard alignment, cable-routing, board-order, and top-access constraints obsolete.
